description: Na₂YSn(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.72 Å. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.27 Å. Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.14 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-38°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-40°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.58 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-40°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sn and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Sn, and one P atom.
